scope: Freestanding non-executing ELF64/x86_64 ET_EXEC and ET_DYN metadata parser
accepted: ELF64 little-endian x86_64 ET_EXEC or ET_DYN header
bounded program-header table and PT_LOAD ranges with file/memory and alignment checks
bounded PT_INTERP policy check with real PIE fixture: reject when policy disabled and accept metadata only when enabled
bounded PT_DYNAMIC tags: DT_STRTAB, DT_STRSZ, DT_NEEDED, DT_RELA, DT_TEXTREL and DT_FLAGS; initial-load policy rejects detected text relocation and writable-executable segment states
real host-built ET_DYN fixture with one or more DT_NEEDED entries
rejected_or_not_implemented: truncated ELF input and malformed range/table/string metadata
ELF mapping, process creation, BSS mapping, relocations, symbol resolution, dependency loading, PT_INTERP invocation, constructors or code execution
Linux/glibc compatibility, a dynamic linker, networking, dpkg, apt or existing Linux package execution
required_output: SeLinOS ELFRT M1: ET_DYN, PT_INTERP and initial W^X policy paths verified.
